🎮Console Supported
🔥Updated 1.9n4
🏆 💍Wizard and More
🏆 New Kamen Rider Riders and forms to be discovered!  
🔓40+ Riders to unlock ,and the roster keeps growing!

🎉 Code: "20mvisits" for 1,000,000 Yen! and 'rw2026' for 6 Dimension Fragments🚀

🎮 Basic Controls
- H : Henshin  
- T : Open Rider Transformation Menu  
- U :  Backpack (Inventory)  
- Z :  Rest  
- B :  Call Bike  
- F : Block  
- Q : Dash  
For mobile players, the corresponding buttons will appear on the screen and Guide for Console at Setting Menu.

🎉Hop into Rider World, play as your favorite Kamen Rider, and collect as many as you can!  
Rider World is a Masked Rider (Kamen Rider) fan game made by LeePungg. Players focus on finding Rider Powers, which are obtained by defeating enemy Riders! Credits for clothing go to JudgeSoup and Blotnik, and thanks to TopbarPlus as well.


⚠️If you have used or are using any exploits or engaging in any unusual behavior that clients or players cannot do, we will not appeal bans.
